$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-finding-regression-pins.mjs (W2-CI-001). Each entry is an F-id that appears in source files but has no declared @pins tag, AND has a deliberate justification — it is a prose cross-reference, not a fix pin (see pin-declarations.mjs's module docstring for why a declared-tag mechanism no longer needs to guess this the way the retired text-heuristic gate did). Cross-references in source comments are the most common legitimate case; this allowlist captures them so the always-on CI gate stays green without forcing a test tag for a prose mention. SCHEMA (dispatch C8, findings 21/22 — every entry requires all four fields, enforced by loadAllowlist, throws if any are missing): { reason: string (why this is not a real pin), file: string (where the mention lives), owner: string (who to ask before changing the disposition — 'coordinator' for cross-domain dispositions minted before this schema existed, the specific domain name for anything owned going forward), revalidate_by: 'YYYY-MM-DD' (a stale-but-still-applied entry is not an error — the gate reports entries past this date as due for a fresh look, per finding 21's ~50% dead-suppression base rate; this is a nudge, not a block). Adding an entry: F-id key, all four fields required. Entries should be revisited each release — if the source reference goes away, drop the allowlist entry; if a declared @pins tag lands for the id instead, the gate itself will report the entry as unused (safe to delete) rather than requiring a human to notice first.
